assignments.evidence: Only after woS (Isis): 'woS mkdi lX', 'woS mk di lX'; it is mk 'god' + kdi 'woman'.
kdi 'woman' + -te (83 tokens) in the kin slot '... NAME kdite lo wi', 'abesye kdite lXlowi' (elder sister), plural 'kdite bes lo'.
Female kin term beside Ste 'mother' in a royal woman's titles: 'Ste li qore sm lo' (mother of ..., wife of the king).
High office before names: 'pelmoS atolis' (of the water, ato), 'pelmoS adblis' (of the land); listed with apote and xrpx.
Closes lists: 'xlbi 3 dime 4 kelw ...', 'mlekeyos treye ... mlekeyos tkreye kelw yetmdebetowi', '... 16 kelw yikidbitelowi'.
Office title in rank lists ('antxSxsliteb yetmdelowi SSor mns mlitowi', 'SSor lX lo wi qoreN l' = great scribe of the king); the other titles go to qore, pelmoS, apote.
Counted livestock beside dime 'cow': 'dmkte qo xlbi 3 dime 4 kelw ...' and 'xlbi 3 dime 24'.
Stands next to royal names: 'qore tNyidamani', 'xrmdoye qore', 'RNAME qore s l', 'RNAME qorelX' (great king).
Opens votive texts: 'tewisti are ke NAME yeSoa' (25 texts), 'tewisti msye woS' addressed to Isis.
Rare kin noun with the copula ('aleqese wide lo'), near kdi/Ste in long texts; the kin meaning left after sister, wife, child, relative.
Only in Hamadab ritual passages, doubled and given to king or god: 'witese yesebe ns ns l qor', 'ns ns l amnp ... mdewi ns seb'; by elimination.
Filiation in 201 texts: 'NAME tedxelowi/tdxelowi NAME terikelowi', the partner of terike/yerike 'begotten by (father)'.
Most frequent kin word: long lists 'TITLE NAME yetmdelowi' after the parents, plural 'yetmde aqebetowi', 'pesto n yetmde betewi'.
'apote arome li s NAME', 'apote lX aromelis' (envoy to Rome), 'apotelw qorete' (to the king); listed with pelmoS and xrpx.
Only in Kharamadoye's itinerary, alternating with Xrw: 'Xrw adonilikete yireqw arw ... Xrw sleleke mtr ws yireqw ade leke', a direction.
Offering formula pairs it with ato 'water': 'ato mXe piSiXekes at mXe piSixrkes' (78 tokens).
'mte pelmoS atolit yerike lo' = child begotten by the general of water; 'ar mte' (boy child); 'amnis mte lo'.
